arxiv-2005-08644.title: Intracranial Hemorrhage Detection Using Neural Network Based Methods With Federated Learning*
arxiv-2005-08644.creator: 1 st Utkarsh Chandra Srivastava, 2 nd Anshuman Singh, 3 nd Dr. K. Sree Kumar
arxiv-2005-08644.description: Abstract Intracranial hemorrhage, bleeding that occurs inside the cranium, is a serious health problem requiring rapid and often intensive medical treatment. Such a condition is traditionally diagnosed by highly-trained specialists analyzing computed tomography (CT) scan of the patient and identifying the location and type of hemorrhage if one exists.

arxiv-2104-14379.title: Learning Robust Variational Information Bottleneck with Reference
arxiv-2104-14379.creator: Weizhu Qian, Bowei Chen, Xiaowei Huang
arxiv-2104-14379.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Weizhu Qian, Bowei Chen, Xiaowei Huang. We propose a new approach to train a variational information bottleneck (VIB) that improves its robustness to adversarial perturbations. Unlike the traditional methods where the hard labels are usually used for the classification task, we refine the categorical class information in the training phase with soft labels which are obtained from a pre-trained reference neural network and can reflect the likelihood of the original class labels.

arxiv-2207-10339.title: Tunneling Analysis of Regular Black Holes with Cosmic Strings-Like Solution in Newman-Janis Algorithm
arxiv-2207-10339.creator: Riasat Ali, Rimsha Babar, Muhammad Asgher, Xia Tie-Cheng
arxiv-2207-10339.description: Abstract We consider the regular black holes solution with cosmic strings(RBHCS) in the rotation parameter by assuming the Newman-Janis method. After this, we study thermodynamical property (i.e., Hawking temperature T H T_{H} ) for the RBHCS in the presence of spin parameter.

arxiv-2405-02444.title: Local existence of solutions to a nonlinear autonomous PDE model for population dynamics with nonlocal transport and competition
arxiv-2405-02444.creator: Michael R. Lindstrom; mike.lindstrom@utrgv.edu
arxiv-2405-02444.description: Abstract In this paper, we prove that a particular nondegenerate, nonlinear, autonomous parabolic partial differential equation with a nonlocal mass transfer admits the local existence of classical solutions. The equation was developed to qualitatively describe temporal changes in population densities over space through accounting for location desirability and fast, long-range travel.

arxiv-2409-06831.title: Atom dimension adaptation for infinite set dictionary learning
arxiv-2409-06831.creator: Andra Băltoiu, Denis C. Ilie-Ablachim, Bogdan Dumitrescu
arxiv-2409-06831.description: Abstract Recent work on dictionary learning with set-atoms has shown benefits in anomaly detection. Instead of viewing an atom as a single vector, these methods allow building sparse representations with atoms taken from a set around a central vector; the set can be a cone or may have a probability distribution associated to it.

arxiv-2506-06600.title: RARL: Improving Medical VLM Reasoning and Generalization with Reinforcement Learning and LoRA under Data and Hardware Constraints
arxiv-2506-06600.creator: Tan-Hanh Pham, Chris Ngo text
arxiv-2506-06600.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tan-Hanh Pham, Chris Ngo text. The growing integration of vision-language models (VLMs) in medical applications offers promising support for diagnostic reasoning. However, current medical VLMs often face limitations in generalization, transparency, and computational efficiency-barriers that hinder deployment in real-world, resource-constrained settings. To address these challenges, we propose a Reasoning-Aware Reinforcement Learning framework, RARL , that enhances the reasoning capabilities of medical VLMs while remaining efficient and adaptable to low-resource environments.

arxiv-2510-26566.title: Multiclass Local Calibration With the Jensen-Shannon Distance
arxiv-2510-26566.creator: Cesare Barbera, Lorenzo Perini, Giovanni De Toni, Andrea Passerini, Andrea Pugnana
arxiv-2510-26566.description: Abstract Developing trustworthy Machine Learning (ML) models requires their predicted probabilities to be well-calibrated, meaning they should reflect true-class frequencies. Among calibration notions in multiclass classification, strong calibration is the most stringent, as it requires all predicted probabilities to be simultaneously calibrated across all classes.

pmc-11452892.creator: Khushbu Balsara, Ali Iftikhar, Panagis Galiatsatos, Carlo DiClemente, Brian Mattingly, Norma F Kanarek
pmc-11452892.description: BackgroundSmoking cessation is linked to improved mental health that encompasses the overall well-being and psychological functioning of an individual.ObjectiveExamine relationships between smoking, mental health, and social connectedness among adults in Maryland, US in 2020.MethodologyThis cross-sectional study used data from the Maryland 2020 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System Survey of adults during the onset of COVID-19.

pmc-11512323.title: Herpesvirus Antibody Response and Occurrence of Symptoms in Acute and Post-Acute COVID-19 Disease
pmc-11512323.creator: Julia Butt, Julia Simon, Tim Waterboer, Uta Merle, Sherif T S Hassan
pmc-11512323.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Knowledge about the underlying causes of the individual occurrence of symptoms during acute COVID-19 disease and during the post-acute sequelae of COVID-19 is limited. In a German COVID-19 follow-up study, we assessed whether elevated antibody responses to herpesviruses were associated with symptom occurrence in acute COVID-19 disease (n = 96 participants) and during 20 months of follow-up (n = 62 participants).

pmc-12453225.title: Epithelial competition determines gene therapy potential to suppress Fanconi Anemia oral cancer risk
pmc-12453225.creator: Hunter L. Colegrove, Raymond J. Monnat Jr., Alison F. Feder
pmc-12453225.description: Fanconi Anemia (FA) is a heritable syndrome characterized by DNA damage repair deficits, frequent malformations and a significantly elevated risk of bone marrow failure, leukemia, and mucosal head and neck squamous cell carcinomas (HNSCC). Hematopoietic stem cell gene therapy can prevent marrow failure and lower leukemia risk, but mucosal gene therapy to lower HNSCC risk remains untested.

pmc-12585764.title: PDBx/mmCIF Ecosystem: Foundation for FAIR Access to Macromolecular Structure Data
pmc-12585764.creator: Brinda Vallat
pmc-12585764.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Protein Data Bank (PDB, wwpdb.org, rcsb.org) is the single global repository for three-dimensional structures of biological macromolecules determined experimentally. PDB has been a pioneer in promoting open science and FAIR data practices worldwide. Open access to curated and validated structural biology data provided by the PDB has been crucial for the development of novel protein structure prediction algorithms, elucidated by recent artificial intelligence-based breakthroughs (e.g., AlphaFold2 and RoseTTAFold). Fundamental to these accomplishments are the creation and adoption of data standards.

pmc-12644869.title: AI driven web crawling for semantic extraction of news content from newspapers
pmc-12644869.creator: Saravanan S, Ashfauk Ahamed A K
pmc-12644869.description: Efficient data extraction from the ever-expanding web, including structured and unstructured sources such as newspaper databases, is critical for industries like media, research, and journalism. Traditional web crawlers, which are primarily rule-based or keyword-driven, struggle with adaptability, semantic understanding, and real-time responsiveness when working with diverse data formats and layouts found in newspaper archives.

pmc-12801774.title: Effect of organismal rhythmic activity on Aβ clearance by the glymphatic system
pmc-12801774.creator: Feiyue Mi, Hailang Li, Dongfeng Pan, Changyin Yu
pmc-12801774.description: Abnormal deposition of β-amyloid (Aβ) is a significant pathological feature of neurodegenerative diseases, particularly Alzheimer’s disease (AD). The glymphatic system (GS) plays a crucial role in Aβ clearance. Various rhythmic activities of the organism dynamically influence Aβ clearance by modulating GS function.

pmc-13048251.title: A stromal PAI1-tPA axis orchestrates immunosuppression in pancreatic cancer
pmc-13048251.creator: Tenzin Ngodup, Brynn Elson, Ashley M. Mello, Sean Hannifin, Miranda Liu, Yaqing Zhang, Jiaqi Shi, Yatrik M. Shah, Daniel A. Lawrence, Marina Pasca di Magliano, Kyoung Eun Lee
pmc-13048251.description: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a lethal malignancy with a dense desmoplastic stroma and an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment that contribute to therapeutic resistance. Here, we identify plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 (PAI1) as a stroma-derived mediator of immune evasion and tumor progression in PDAC.

pmc-13291853.title: Reporting of Rurality, Deprivation, and Socioeconomic Characteristics in Cancer Clinical Trials
pmc-13291853.creator: Joseph M. Unger
pmc-13291853.description: Key PointsQuestionHow frequently are geographic, socioeconomic, and core demographic characteristics reported in randomized clinical trial primary publications in oncology?FindingsIn this systematic review of 441 US-based randomized clinical trial primary reports, reporting of age and sex was common, and reporting of race and ethnicity has increased substantially over time.

pmc-13428190.title: Genetic basis of Asian diabetes
pmc-13428190.creator: Takafumi Ojima, Toshimasa Yamauchi
pmc-13428190.description: Recent genomic studies in Asian populations have advanced our understanding of the diagnosis, pathophysiology, risk prediction, and precision care of diabetes. Monogenic diabetes, including maturity‐onset diabetes of the young (MODY) and mitochondrial diabetes, highlights the importance of genetic diagnosis for subtype‐specific care.
